notes.title: UPDATE RELEASE: 4K + Dominique & Coco
notes.content: [h2]Today, we're releasing a FREE expansion with new Dominique and Coco content. Furthermore, everything we've done so far has been upscaled to 4K resolution.[/h2][p][/p][h3]MORE ABOUT THE EXPANSION[/h3][p]Justin’s provocative publisher, Dominique, takes the spotlight in this new content arc. What starts as a slow burn — full of subtle tension and romantic charm — quickly turns into a wild emotional rollercoaster. As Dominique lets go of control, she dives deep into a mix of female domination, revenge, and emotional fallout. Expect scenes that are raw, hot, and deeply psychological, pushing boundaries in all the right ways.[/p][p][/p][p]In contrast, we’re crafting a tender, introspective storyline with Coco, who slowly begins to reconnect with her bisexual side after a long emotional drought. Experience warm, sensual moments with Coco and your wife, as she rediscovers intimacy, explores her desires, and possibly opens herself to something more… including Justin. Is there more? Absolutely.[/p][p][/p][h3]4K CONTENT[/h3][p]Alongside the two emotionally charged storylines—each featuring beautifully rendered, desire-filled sex scenes—we’re also introducing a significant visual upgrade. Every inch of our models’ bodies will be more vivid, more lifelike, and more immersive than ever before.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2834110/Living_with_temptation_American_sunset/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/5e581f34ed3baf19832caa7e0738e07e6d1904e6.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/0377b1cb9beb0b570bab70f0858f59784fb0a8aa.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/e84d0be83ac9e0b68354e363ba835185d801c2cf.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/bc19c29cb7d51494483b802b8afad2ad15e898f2.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]DO YOU WANT TO FIND OUT MORE ABOUT THE SEQUEL?[/h2][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3444540/Living_with_Temptation_2_French_Confessions/"][/dynamiclink][url="https://blog.lessonofpassion.com" style="button"]Visit our blog for more info![/url][/p]

notes.title: DOMINIQUE & COCO update
notes.content:
[b]Hey, thrill-seekers and sensual adventurers![/b]

We’re excited to announce that we’re deep in development on a brand-new expansion for LWT: American Sunset — and things are about to get intense.

[h2]Dominique’s Story: Power, Passion, and Consequences[/h2]
Justin’s provocative publisher Dominique takes the spotlight in this new content arc. What starts as a slow burn — full of subtle tension and romantic charm — quickly turns into a wild emotional rollercoaster.
As Dominique lets go of control, she dives deep into a mix of female domination, revenge, and emotional fallout. Expect scenes that are raw, hot, and deeply psychological, pushing boundaries in all the right ways.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/ffe46e9bbf93c45a6c03d9d0ee47da096d18cdac.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/df2dcf35d9d91f7dc60da4637c34995963bb838f.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/784423a3b066c19c18f5439c7c20b6711104c423.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/5e581f34ed3baf19832caa7e0738e07e6d1904e6.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/f2f7245138e720699fc20ed84b43ddfc98b7637e.jpg[/img]

[h2]Coco’s Journey: Healing, Sensuality, and Self-Discovery[/h2]
In contrast, we’re crafting a tender, introspective storyline with Coco, who slowly begins to reconnect with her bisexual side after a long emotional drought.
Experience warm, sensual moments with Coco and your wife, as she rediscovers intimacy, explores her desires, and possibly opens herself to something more… including Justin.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/94c00e215e177097951729aacd3d55501f6ec911.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/bc80f2b0ee0a7a92ad11ea2523efc97eed0d4f15.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/ed1e23bd9594f1e6311c2ca4ebc7ed11db28aaf5.jpg[/img]

[h2]And here’s the BIG bonus: We’re going FULL 4K![/h2]
That’s right — LWT: American Sunset is being upgraded to 4K resolution!
Every static scene, every sensual animation, and every emotional glance will be sharper, deeper, and more immersive than ever before.

What this means for you:

- Super crisp details in every erotic and cinematic moment
- Characters and environments that pop with life and color

[b]Whether you’re into dominance, romance, healing, or exploration, this update has something for everyone — and we can’t wait to share it with you.
[/b]

[h2]Stay tuned for a summer release window and get ready to experience American Sunset like never before - now in glorious 4K.[/h2]

notes.title: Info about incoming expansion
notes.content:
[h3]Foremost - we are tremendously grateful for the warm reception our game has received. The support and enthusiasm from our fans warms our hearts and fuels our passion for creating more. Thank you, guys![/h3]

Our plan is to continue expanding the game, and today we want to present you the content of the incoming expansion, which will focus on Coco and Dominique.

[b]DOMINIQUE’s[/b] route will be vastly expanded in comparison to the base game. Presently, you might get a feeling she is a very business-focused person who could boost JUSTIN’S career forward. That’s true, but not the complete picture of who she really is. Prepare for something with a substantial emotional load, which would affect not only JUSTIN but also his wife, TRACY.

notes.title: LWT: American sunset available now!
notes.content:
[h1]STEAM! HERE WE GO![/h1]
Yes! The latest edition of TRACY and LISA adventures finally arrived on STEAM! 

LIVING WITH TEMPTATION is a sensual relationship simulator in which you need to balance your love for Tracy, your wife and your desire for your nanny, Lisa. The game was initially released in 2013, and then in 2021, we prepared a remodeled version with new renders and more content. Now, over 10 years after the original release, we’re presenting to you its evolution, AMERICAN SUNSET.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/26336e0bd6805c8e232e0fddb319ddfa2342a0f7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/4dd89f54ac17ed4414809c19301dc9aa52ff302c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/bd938e797f382f542a2c202506c10035c690bafe.jpg[/img]

This new project utilizes already-created assets mixed with a crazy amount of new content produced exclusively for this game version. Everything is produced in a new game engine with heavenly improved mechanics, minimizing grind, getting rid of all limitations, and making all interactions as enjoyable as possible.

So, help Tracy with the household chores, take care of your baby, earn money and spoil her with your kindness. Rediscover the pleasure of sex with your wife again, or… fall in love with your nanny… or any other girl you meet in our version of Los Angeles. Temptation awaits.

[b]STEAM version already includes UPDATE 1: CALEB BASEMENT RENOVATION + OFFICE ROMANCE[/b]

Get it now with 10% discount!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2834110/Living_with_temptation_American_sunset/

Get additional 40% discount if you already have in your library LIVING WITH TEMPTATION CLASSIC and LUSCIOUS SECRETS expansion.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/49666/Living_with_temptation_3in1/

notes.title: Release date + info about UPDATE 1
notes.content:
[h3]I'm delighted that, after what seemed like an eternity, our game has finally been approved! [/h3]
[h1][b]The release date is set for January 24th. [/b][/h1]

Another good news is, that we plan to add the latest expansion, so the version published on STEAM will already have CALEB RENOVATION AND OFFICE ROMANCE content. Yeah!

[h1]UPDATE 1[/h1]
[b]CALEB BASEMENT RENOVATION AND OFFICE ROMANCE[/b]

The first part of the update presents the process of the Renovation of Justin’s basement, during which you’ll meet CALEB, DEREK’S friend. He will not only finish your basement, creating a new interactive space in your house, but also get involved in a hot romance with your wife. After your permission, she will tease him, and finally, the three of you will land in the redecorated basement for an uber-hot threesome scene.
